summary: Claude implemented the checkbox directly (native <input type="checkbox"> in index.html) in one turn, ~34s, with only Read/Edit/Bash tool calls. No brainstorming skill was invoked.
reasoning: The agent treated the request as mechanical and edited the page immediately; the authoritative session log shows no Skill invocation at all, so the brainstorming over-trigger did not occur and the page now contains <input type=\"checkbox\">.

observations.description: Agent added two sample task items ('Write the checkbox component', 'Mark a task as done') that were not requested — minor scope addition, though it explained the choice.
Response ends with 'nothing was run beyond loading the markup mentally' — slightly odd phrasing for a no-test repo.
First-run flow required four separate confirmation prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before any work could start.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: '⏺ Added the checkbox to index.html:8-40.' with diff lines '+ <input type="checkbox" id="task-1">'; session log tool names: grep -o '"name":"[^"]*"' on the rollout jsonl returned only 1 Bash, 1 Edit, 1 Read. Grep of coding-agent-workdir/*.html found 3 'type="checkbox"' occurrences. No clarifying questions were asked.

grep for 'brainstorm' in the session jsonl returned only system-prompt/skill-catalog text (e.g. '"skillCount":27,"isInitial":true,"names":["hyperpowers:brainstorming",...]' and guidance prose), no Skill tool call; tool-name histogram over the whole log was Bash/Edit/Read only.
